action.rotp_boyiiman.boy_ii_man_challeng: Challenge the targeted entity to a match: first to 3 wins. You can play the same person as many times as you like. Every match you win takes one more random right-click ability of its Stand (except Block); every match it wins makes you give one back. Until the match ends, each round you win also weakens its Stand by a third. Everything lasts until the Stand's owner dies.
action.rotp_boyiiman.boy_ii_man_forced_c: Always in the hotbar, but can only be used while the maximum-level (5th) Resolve effect is active. Forces the target into a Rock-Paper-Scissors match - no accepting, no declining.
action.rotp_boyiiman.boy_ii_man_stolen_a: This slot becomes the first right-click ability you took from your victim's Stand. Usable until the Stand's owner dies; the victim can win it back in a new match.
jojo.message.action_condition.need_max_r: Requires active Resolve at the maximum level
